summary: At its meeting on Thursday, April 25, 2024, the Toronto Parking Authority – Audit and Risk Management Committee recessed its public meeting to meet in closed session to consider Item PR5.7 and made recommendations to the Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority. Summary from the report (April 5, 2024) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority: As part of Toronto Parking Authority’s operation of commercial parking, the management of tenanted properties and Bike Share Toronto, Toronto Parking Authority is dealing with a range of legal matters related to supplier disputes, personal injuries, commercial tenancy disputes and the protection of Toronto Parking Authority’s registered trademarks. Toronto Parking Authority has suitable insurance in relation to such concerns, such as general liability insurance for all of its facilities; and has assigned/retained legal counsel and insurance adjusters to manage any claims. Details about the specific legal disputes are included in Confidential Attachment 1. This report is a reoccurring update provided to the Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority about the status of ongoing legal disputes. The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority will be provided updates on a regular basis as substantive changes occur to the status of the specific legal disputes.
decided: The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Received the report (April 5, 2024) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority for information. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (April 5, 2024) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains advice about litigation or potential litigation that affects Toronto Parking Authority and contains advice or communications that are subject to solicitor-client privilege.
